description: Hand-written: the audio.ground.* rows' own contract (PL.native-ground-row, U97(3); core's ground reading, PL.ground-from-ir, U94(5)) — the contract row's data, each row's answer shape, what core reads itself going to core unchecked (an absent world or a world that is not an object, an absent or non-finite position, an absent or unknown gait), the open ground a default and never a refusal, and an archetype read by its ancestor for the step. Core's own corpus (conformance/audio/ground.json, 48 cases) is driven whole through these rows by the audio_ground_corpus ctest (tests/props_corpus.cpp), not transcribed here. Then the step clock (PL.native-step-clock-row, U122(1); core's stepFootsteps, P5.core): audio.footsteps.contract's data and initial state; audio.stepFootsteps stateless over the state it is sent, with a witness for a long frame spanning several intervals (one step, the remainder folded) and one for idle resetting the state; an unknown gait or surface a value as core answers it; zero and negative frames moving nothing; and the row's [invalid-input] boundary (a missing or non-finite dtSec, a state that is not a clock state). Those expectations are core's own answers at the pin (gen-bridge-step-clock-cases.mts, kept with the builder's record). Core's cue corpus (conformance/audio/cues.json: its 7 footstepRun and 26 footstep cases) is driven through the row by the audio_cues_corpus ctest, not transcribed here.

cases.name: audio.ground.contract: the ground corpus's data, from core's constants
audio.ground: placeAt, groundSurfaceAt and footstepAt over one world; the open ground is a default; no position is no reading
audio.footsteps.contract: the cue corpus footstep data and the initial state, from core constants
audio.stepFootsteps: a long frame spanning several intervals lets ONE step fall and folds the remainder below one interval (witness)
audio.stepFootsteps: idle resets the state to the initial one (witness), as does every body that does not step
audio.stepFootsteps: an unknown gait or surface is a value, as core answers it: no step, or the default surface marked default
audio.stepFootsteps: a zero or negative frame moves nothing; the same call twice answers the same (the row holds no state)
the audio.stepFootsteps boundary: a missing or non-finite dtSec, or a state that is not a clock state, is [invalid-input]
